title: Grace Period and Lapse Terms by Arrangement — Premium Billing Accounts
content:
Each Premium Billing Accounts arrangement carries the grace and lapse terms set out below.

**Definitions used in the table**
- *Grace period (days)* — calendar days after the due date during which coverage continues while premium is unpaid (non-APTC accounts); 0 when the account uses the APTC grace instead.
- *APTC grace (months)* — consecutive calendar months of grace for an exchange account receiving advance premium tax credit that has paid its binder; 0 when not applicable.
- *APTC eligible* — whether the arrangement can receive advance premium tax credit from the exchange.
- *Claims pended from grace month* — month of the APTC grace period (counted from 1) from which claims are pended rather than paid; 0 when not applicable.
- *APTC lapse termination basis* — termination date when an APTC grace period ends unpaid: end of first grace month; not applicable otherwise.
- *Lapse termination basis* — termination date when a non-APTC grace period ends unpaid: the paid-through date.
- *Grace notice* — whether a grace notice is sent when the account enters grace (the grace period runs whether or not the notice is read).
- *APTC returned on lapse* — advance premium tax credit for grace months after the first is returned to the exchange when an APTC account lapses (months 2 and 3); not applicable otherwise.

| Arrangement | Grace period (days) | APTC grace (months) | APTC eligible | Claims pended from grace month | APTC lapse termination basis | Lapse termination basis | Grace notice | APTC returned on lapse |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly | 31 | 0 | no | 0 | not applicable | paid-through date | yes | not applicable |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | 31 | 0 | no | 0 | not applicable | paid-through date | yes | not applicable |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | 31 | 0 | no | 0 | not applicable | paid-through date | yes | not applicable |
| Cascade Individual Annual Prepay | 31 | 0 | no | 0 | not applicable | paid-through date | yes | not applicable |
| Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly | 31 | 3 | yes | 2 | end of first grace month | paid-through date | yes | months 2 and 3 |
| Cascade Group List Bill | 31 | 0 | no | 0 | not applicable | paid-through date | yes | not applicable |
| Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill | 31 | 0 | no | 0 | not applicable | paid-through date | yes | not applicable |

**Points of reading.** Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly is the only arrangement able to receive advance premium tax credit; on such an account, once the binder is paid, the grace is 3 consecutive calendar months, claims are pended from grace month 2, an unpaid lapse terminates coverage at the end of the first grace month, and the credit for months 2 and 3 goes back to the exchange. Every arrangement sends a grace notice, and the grace period runs whether or not it is read.
